LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_AerialSupport.label: Aerial Support
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_AerialSupport.description: A test ability. Use it to summon all types of aerial support.
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_RepairDesignate.label: Repair Designate
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_EmergencyRepair.label: Emergency Repair
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_EmergencyRepair.description: The mechanoid gains 500% global work speed for three hours. Cooldown: two days.
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_MechReconstruction.label: Mech Reconstruction
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_MechReconstruction.descript: An Engineer will attempt to repair and restart a shut-down mechanoid. Can only be used on friendly mechanoid corpses.
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_OmnimindSilence.label: Omnimind Silence
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_OmnimindSilence.description: Applies 1 hour of psychic camouflage to the caster and allied mechanoids within 3 tiles.
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_HighVoltageShock.label: High-Voltage Shock
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_HighVoltageShock.descriptio: Consumes 25% of the mechanoid's maximum energy to shock the target, causing 12 hours of electroshock coma.
LanguageData.DMSL_Ability_HighVoltageShock.comps.0.di: High-Voltage Shock requires at least 26% maximum energy.
